macros.name: JSONParse
macros.doc: The command \JSONParse is used to parse a JSON string and globally store the parsed result in a token variable (a property list).

macros.name: JSONParse
macros.doc: The command \JSONParse is used to parse a JSON string and globally store the parsed result in a token variable (a property list).

macros.name: JSONParseArrayCount
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseArrayCount takes as first mandatory argument a token variable holding a parsed JSON string or JSON file and as second mandatory argument a key to select an array in the JSON data. It returns an integer representing the number of items contained in the selected array.

macros.name: JSONParseArrayCount
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseArrayCount takes as first mandatory argument a token variable holding a parsed JSON string or JSON file and as second mandatory argument a key to select an array in the JSON data. It returns an integer representing the number of items contained in the selected array.

macros.name: JSONParseArrayMapFunction
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseArrayMapFunction accepts code before and code after as options. These options can be used to place code before and after the output that is generated by the command called for every array item, for example for typesetting tabular contents.

macros.name: JSONParseArrayMapFunction
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseArrayMapFunction accepts code before and code after as options. These options can be used to place code before and after the output that is generated by the command called for every array item, for example for typesetting tabular contents.

macros.name: JSONParseArrayUse
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseArrayUse is used to select all values from an array from a parsed JSON string or JSON file.

macros.name: JSONParseArrayUse
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseArrayUse is used to select all values from an array from a parsed JSON string or JSON file.

macros.name: JSONParseExpandableValue
macros.doc: Whole objects or arrays can be output as JSON string for further use in other macros using the expandable command \JSONParseExpandableValue .

macros.name: JSONParseFilter
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseFilter is used to select a part (such as an object or an array) of a JSON object or JSON array and parse this into a token variable (a property list).

macros.name: JSONParseFromFile
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseFromFile is used to parse a JSON file and store the parsed result in a token variable (a property list).

macros.name: JSONParseFromFile
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseFromFile is used to parse a JSON file and store the parsed result in a token variable (a property list).

macros.name: JSONParseKeys
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseKeys is used to get all top-level keys of a JSON object as JSON array and return this array as string where all characters (except for spaces and tabs) have category code 12 (“other”).

macros.name: JSONParseKeys
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseKeys is used to get all top-level keys of a JSON object as JSON array and return this array as string where all characters (except for spaces and tabs) have category code 12 (“other”).

macros.name: JSONParsePut
macros.doc: The command \JSONParsePut is used by the externalization procedure to re-read already parsed JSON data to the main file.

macros.name: JSONParseSet
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseSet can be used to specify options via key-value pairs (separated by commas).

macros.name: JSONParseValue
macros.doc: The command \JSONParseValue is used to select values from the token variable (property list) that has been created using the commands \JSONParse or \JSONParseFromFile .
